notes: SMA4 is first defined at bar 3; a crossover needs SMA4 at bar 2 as well, so no signal can exist before bar 4.
From bar 3 on SMA2 is already above SMA4 and stays above, so there is never a crossover.
An implementation that averages a partial window would see SMA2 2010 < partial-SMA4 2016.67 at bar 2 and fire a false golden cross at bar 3 (entry bar 4 open 2040).
